article_title: September reset: Why now is the time to start a new routine and how to stick to it

tasks.prompt: What is the central message of the article?
options: September routines should copy strict New Year's resolutions
September can help people build small, well-planned habits that last
People should avoid changing routines after summer
A reset requires a radical overhaul of life
tasks.correct_answer: September can help people build small, well-planned habits that last
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציגה את ספטמבר כהזדמנות לשינויים קטנים, תכנון והפיכת ההתנהגות הרצויה לאפשרות הקלה.

tasks.prompt: Why might September make people more open to changing their habits?
options: Returning to work or school disrupts old patterns and creates a chance to reorient
Social media removes the need to plan
Everyone has more free time in September
New habits work only in cooler weather
tasks.correct_answer: Returning to work or school disrupts old patterns and creates a chance to reorient
tasks.explanation_hebrew: שיבוש בשגרה יכול ליצור חלון שבו אנשים מגיבים יותר לשינוי ולדרכי פעולה חלופיות.

tasks.prompt: What are “major life overhauls” in the description of New Year's resolutions?
options: Brief breaks from work
Lists of social-media videos
Large and comprehensive changes to one's life
Small actions requiring little effort
tasks.correct_answer: Large and comprehensive changes to one's life
tasks.explanation_hebrew: overhaul הוא שינוי יסודי ומקיף; ה־September Reset מוצג כחלופה מתונה יותר.

tasks.prompt: What does Cami recommend choosing after reviewing earlier goals?
options: A spreadsheet of radical changes
A completely new career
Ten compulsory workouts
Three small non-negotiable actions
tasks.explanation_hebrew: קאמי ממליצה לבחור שלושה הרגלים קטנים, למשל פרי בבוקר או מים לפני קפה.

tasks.prompt: What does Cami mean when meal preparation has “removed the friction”?
options: It removed an obstacle, making the preferred breakfast easier
It made the oats smoother
It stopped food becoming warm
It added more morning choices
tasks.correct_answer: It removed an obstacle, making the preferred breakfast easier
tasks.explanation_hebrew: friction בהקשר זה הוא קושי או מעצור; הכנת המזון מראש מקלה לבחור בו.

tasks.prompt: What does “automatically” suggest about a habit formed through a specific plan?
options: It is performed by a machine
The desired choice happens with little fresh decision-making
It changes whenever the situation changes
It needs a new written plan every time
tasks.correct_answer: The desired choice happens with little fresh decision-making
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לאחר תכנון וחזרה, הבחירה נעשית כמעט מעצמה וללא החלטה חדשה בכל פעם.

tasks.prompt: Explain the research idea Professor Verplanken uses to support a September reset.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר שינוי גדול, תגובתיות להתערבות, שיבוש הרגלים והאפשרות לבחור חלופות.
expected_points: A major change can disrupt established habits
People who moved house were more responsive to an intervention
The intervention promoted sustainable behaviour
Returning to work or school can similarly create a chance to reorient

tasks.prompt: How do Cami's Sunday planning and meal preparation make her routine easier to follow?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד תכנון מראש מצמצם בחירות ומסיר מכשולים ברגע הפעולה.
expected_points: She plans meals and workouts
She may plan work outfits
She prepares several breakfasts in advance
Ready food becomes the natural choice
Planning limits opportunities to stray

tasks.prompt: Summarise why September can support a reset and how the article says new habits can last.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את המעבר מהקיץ, צעדים קטנים, תכנון ספציפי, הסרת חיכוך וחזרה.
expected_points: September restores structure after summer
Disruption can make people receptive to change
Review goals and choose small non-negotiables
Plan where, when and what to do
Prepare in advance and limit unhelpful choices
Repeat behaviour until it becomes effortless

tasks.prompt: Design a realistic seven-day September reset using the article's principles.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב תוכנית באנגלית עם מטרה, שלושה צעדים, זמן ומקום, הכנה מראש וצמצום חיכוך.
expected_points: Choose one realistic goal
Define three small behaviours
State where and when each happens
Include a planning session
Remove at least one obstacle
Avoid a radical overhaul
Explain how repetition builds a routine
